title: The Two Axes of Workload Demand
summary: WLU separates the total amount of work (WLU) from the required delivery rate (WLU/second).
why: A scheduler must be able to react to delivery shortfalls (capacity) independently of the total work entitlement (amount).
invariants: Increasing delivery rate (acceleration) does not change the total WLU amount.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:16-25 explaining the difference between '20 WLU' and '20 WLU over 4 seconds' (5 WLU/s).
